title: Simple Nested List

illustrates.quote: The main entry begins in cell 1. Each subentry level begins two cells to the right of the previous level. All runovers begin two cells to the right of the farthest indented subentry. One level: 1-3 ... (See Sample 8-9: Simple Nested List on page 8-22.)

braille.notes: Main entries (company names) begin in cell 1; each address subentry begins in cell 3 (two cells to the right), per the 'One level: 1-3' margin pattern in 8.5.1.b. Line 5 (blank) precedes the list and line 15 (blank) follows it.
